messages.content: "Could you help me plan my day? I need to go from my home at 123 Main Street to my office at 456 Park Avenue, and I don't want to spend more than $30 on the ride. After work, I need to order groceries from the Whole Foods at 789 Broadway. The items I need are milk, bread, eggs, and apples. I don't want to spend more than $10 on delivery. Then, I need to get a ride from my office to my friend's house at 321 Elm Street, and I don't want to spend more than $20 on that ride. Finally, I need to get a ride from my friend's house back to my home, and I don't want to spend more than $25 on that ride. Can you help me with all of this?"

We need to do:

1. Ride from home (123 Main Street) to office (456 Park Avenue), max cost $30.
2. Grocery order from Whole Foods at 789 Broadway, items: milk, bread, eggs, apples, max delivery cost $10.
3. Ride from office to friend's house at 321 Elm Street, max cost $20.
4. Ride from friend's house back to home, max cost $25.

We should call the functions in order. The user wants help with all of this. So we will call the functions sequentially. The first function: ride_hailing_get_rides with source "123 Main Street", destination "456 Park Avenue", max_cost 30.0. Then grocery_delivery_order with location "Whole Foods at 789 Broadway", items ["milk", "bread", "eggs", "apples"], max_delivery_cost 10.0. Then ride_hailing_get_rides with source "456 Park Avenue", destination "321 Elm Street", max_cost 20.0. Then ride_hailing_get_rides with source "321 Elm Street", destination "123 Main Street", max_cost 25.0.

We need to output the function calls. The user didn't ask for anything else. So we just call the functions.
